items.text: ETR Sunday summary lists Puka Nacua as EXPECTED TO PLAY after IN designation; Schefter reports Rams do not intend to limit his workload vs Eagles.
items.why: Hip return confirmed; workload unrestricted per sources.
items.implication: Full or near-full WR1 role vs depleted Eagles secondary.
items.opportunity: High routes/targets expected without snap restriction.

items.text: Commanders WR Terry McLaurin (hamstring) officially inactive vs Colts in London.
items.why: Hamstring suffered late in practice week.

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey (foot) likely to play after LP-DNP-LP week; injury less serious than prior rib issue. ETR lists EXPECTED TO PLAY.
items.why: Source confirmation; full Friday limited but cleared path.
items.implication: Startable WR with volume upside if full snaps.
items.opportunity: Primary target share in Chargers offense.
items.conflict: Levitan noted caution on practice pattern.

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers (hamstring) expected to play; was Q. ETR confirms EXPECTED TO PLAY.
items.why: Limited week but source says will play, full workload likely.
items.opportunity: High target share, no pitch count.

items.text: Mike Evans GTD/OPTIMISTIC after Q; Rapoport notes practiced late week, optimistic, will do best despite ribs (Kittle: fractured ribs suck).
items.implication: Monitor inactives; if out boosts Kittle.

items.text: Baker Mayfield dislocated thumb expected to sideline 3-6 weeks depending on grip recovery. Undrafted Jalon Daniels first rookie QB start this year.
items.implication: TB offense downgrade; streamer/backup QB opportunities.

items.text: Panthers WR Jalen Coker (quad) listed Q but unlikely to play vs Lions. ETR NOT EXPECTED.
Eagles situation worse: without DeVonta Smith, Dallas Goedert, Zack Baun vs Rams.
items.why: Key pass catchers and LB out.
items.implication: Offense degraded; Wicks/others elevate, Rams defense boosted.
items.opportunity: Increased opportunity for remaining Eagles pass-catchers.

items.text: Great to have Puka Nacua (hip) back; speculation on snap limits but we'll see. Excellent return spot.
items.why: Hip resolved enough for return; later confirmed no limit.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets vs Eagles missing key defenders.

items.text: Excellent spot for Nico Collins (hamstring) return. Cowboys DvP inflates opposing WR scoring +7.3% (most in NFL); Texans 7th-most implied points.
items.opportunity: High target share in favorable DvP.

items.text: Jordan Addison truthers moment: home vs borderline secondary with Justin Jefferson out.
items.why: Jefferson OUT opens targets; strong home matchup.

items.text: Key OUTs include Justin Jefferson, Breece Hall, DeVonta Smith, Dallas Goedert, Jadarian Price (IR), De'Von Achane, Jayden Daniels, Caleb Williams, Baker Mayfield.
items.implication: Major role shifts and handcuff/beneficiary plays.
items.opportunity: Various backups and remaining targets elevate.

items.text: LOVE Garrett Wilson @ CHI: AD Mitchell likely out again; 36% TS last without him; 78% catch rate, 9.0 YPT; CHI allows 14+ YPR. Parlay lean too.
LOVE Jaylen Warren @ CLE: 90% snaps last week, 20/22 RB touches; Dowdle out; CLE allows 88+ rush yds every game.
items.why: Workhorse role confirmed with Dowdle out.

items.text: LOVE Jeremiyah Love @ NYG: RB5 utilization, 26 touches last week (more than W1+2 combined); NYG allows 5.1 YPC; double-digit target share every game.
LOVE Drake London @ NO: 35% career TS /104 ypg with Penix; 43.5% TS last week (9-194); NO allows 5th-most WR TDs.
LOVE Josh Downs vs WSH: 31% TS last two, 43% RZ looks; WSH allows most WR fantasy pts and slot TDs.
items.why: Slot volume + soft matchup (McLaurin out helps Indy too).

items.text: LOVE George Kittle vs DEN: climbing TS/routes (27% W3); Evans day-to-day ribs; DEN allows 8th-most TE yds.
